name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 13 - Am 83
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 13a. Calls for the establishment of an EU transparency register on real estate transactions and ownership as a tool to ensure full transparency on beneficial housing ownership and prevent distortions as well as any money laundering in the housing sector;
